samples.name: Markdown
samples.md:
## A weekend in Lisbon

Lisbon is **compact and hilly**. Most of what you want to see sits between Baixa and Belém, and the trams cover the steep parts.

![Belém Tower on the Tagus](data:image/png;base64,)

- Day one: Alfama, the castle, a fado dinner
- Day two: Belém, pastries, the river walk
- Day three: Sintra by train (40 minutes from Rossio)

| Neighbourhood | Good for | From the centre |
|---|---|---|
| Alfama | Old streets, fado | 10 min walk |
| Belém | Monuments, pastries | 20 min by tram |
| Príncipe Real | Gardens, shops | 15 min walk |

> The 28 tram is lovely but packed after 10:00. Ride it early.

Book the castle online with `code LISBOA10` for 10% off.
